summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the backend advanced-packaging/test overflow node. The cleanest reference asset is Amkor as a US-listed OSAT with direct advanced packaging and test exposure. The more underfollowed lane centers on FormFactor for HBM probe cards, Cohu for HBM inspection/test handlers, and MKS Instruments/Atotech for advanced-packaging plating chemistry/equipment. These are research candidates only, not buy/sell recommendations. Key uncertainty: whether AI/HBM capacity pressure converts into sustained revenue and margin expansion for these suppliers rather than remaining concentrated at TSMC, memory IDMs, or Asia-listed OSATs such as Powertech.
